statement.ru: Китовая акула охотится на тюленей.
statement.en: A whale shark hunts seals.

why: False: the whale shark is a filter feeder eating plankton, krill and small fish.

statement.ru: Акула за жизнь может сменить больше десяти тысяч зубов.
statement.en: A shark can go through more than ten thousand teeth in its life.

why: True: teeth are replaced constantly; some sharks lose 30,000 or more in a lifetime.

statement.ru: Морской конёк — это рыба.
statement.en: A seahorse is a fish.

why: True: seahorses are small marine bony fish of the genus Hippocampus.

statement.ru: Стив Ирвин, «Охотник на крокодилов», погиб от зубов крокодила.
statement.en: Steve Irwin, the Crocodile Hunter, was killed by a crocodile.

why: False: he died from a stingray's barb while filming on the Great Barrier Reef.

statement.ru: Мегалодон до сих пор водится в глубинах океана.
statement.en: Megalodon still lives in the depths of the ocean.

why: False: megalodon went extinct about 3.6 million years ago.

statement.ru: Рыба-фугу надувается, заглатывая воду.
statement.en: A pufferfish blows itself up by gulping water.

why: True: it fills its elastic stomach with water (or air when out of the water).

statement.ru: Электрический угорь бьёт током сильнее, чем напряжение в розетке.
statement.en: An electric eel's shock has a higher voltage than a wall socket.

why: True: electric eels can discharge up to 860 V, against 220 to 240 V in a socket.

statement.ru: Яд рыбы-фугу разрушается, если её как следует проварить.
statement.en: Pufferfish poison is destroyed if you cook the fish well enough.

why: False: tetrodotoxin is heat stable, so cooking does not make it safe.

statement.ru: Лосось мечет икру в открытом океане.
statement.en: Salmon spawn out in the open ocean.

why: False: salmon return from the sea to freshwater rivers and streams to spawn.

statement.ru: Рыба-капля при опасности раздувается, как шар.
statement.en: A blobfish puffs up like a ball when in danger.

why: False: the blobfish is a gelatinous deep-sea fish; puffing up is what pufferfish do.

statement.ru: Тихоокеанские лососи погибают вскоре после нереста.
statement.en: Pacific salmon die soon after spawning.

why: True: in all Pacific salmon species the adults die within days or weeks of spawning.

statement.ru: Морские рыбы пьют морскую воду.
statement.en: Sea fish drink sea water.

why: True: marine fish lose water to the sea, so they drink seawater and pass out the salt.

statement.ru: Европейские угри плывут на нерест через Атлантику, в Саргассово море.
statement.en: European eels swim across the Atlantic to spawn in the Sargasso Sea.

why: True: they spawn in the Sargasso Sea and the larvae drift back to Europe.

statement.ru: Рыбы дышат кислородом, который отщепляют от молекул воды.
statement.en: Fish breathe oxygen that they split off water molecules.

why: False: gills take up oxygen gas dissolved in the water, not the O in H2O.

statement.ru: Рыба-капля в своей родной глубине выглядит как обычная рыба.
statement.en: Down in its home depths, a blobfish looks like an ordinary fish.

why: True: the droopy blob look comes from decompression when it is hauled up; at depth it looks like a fish.

statement.ru: Рыбу-попугая назвали так за то, что она подражает звукам.
statement.en: The parrotfish got its name because it imitates sounds.

why: False: it is named for its parrot-like beak of fused teeth (and bright colours).

statement.ru: Некоторые рыбы-попугаи спят в «спальном мешке» из собственной слизи.
statement.en: Some parrotfish sleep in a 'sleeping bag' made of their own slime.

why: True: queen parrotfish and others wrap themselves in a mucus cocoon at night, likely hiding their scent.

statement.ru: Скат — близкий родственник камбалы.
statement.en: A ray is a close relative of the flounder.

why: False: rays are cartilaginous fish in the same subclass as sharks; flounders are bony fish.

statement.ru: Рыба-меч подогревает себе глаза особым органом.
statement.en: A swordfish warms its eyes with a special organ.

why: True: heater organs keep its eyes 10 to 15 °C warmer than the water.

statement.ru: Пираньи водятся в реках Африки.
statement.en: Piranhas live in the rivers of Africa.

why: False: piranhas live only in South American rivers.

statement.ru: Рыба-брызгун сбивает насекомых струёй воды изо рта.
statement.en: An archerfish knocks insects down with a jet of water from its mouth.

why: True: it shoots down insects on leaves with water spat from its mouth.

statement.ru: Золотая рыбка видит мир чёрно-белым.
statement.en: A goldfish sees the world in black and white.

why: False: goldfish have four kinds of cones and see colours, even ultraviolet.

statement.ru: Сельди издают звуки, выпуская газ из-под хвоста.
statement.en: Herrings make sounds by letting out gas from their rear end.

why: True: the 2004 Ig Nobel prize went to research showing herrings make ticking sounds by releasing gas from the anus.

statement.ru: Анчоусы — это мальки сардин.
statement.en: Anchovies are baby sardines.

why: False: anchovies are their own family, Engraulidae, not young sardines.

statement.ru: Рыба-луна вымётывает до 300 миллионов икринок за раз.
statement.en: An ocean sunfish lays up to 300 million eggs at a time.

why: True: it produces more eggs than any other known vertebrate, up to 300 million at a time.

statement.ru: Латимерия вымерла вместе с динозаврами.
statement.en: The coelacanth died out along with the dinosaurs.

why: False: it was thought extinct, but a live one was caught off South Africa in 1938.

statement.ru: Скат-манта бывает шириной в семь метров.
statement.en: A manta ray can be seven metres wide.

why: True: the giant oceanic manta reaches 7 m in width.

statement.ru: Электрический угорь — близкий родственник обычного угря.
statement.en: The electric eel is a close relative of the common eel.

why: False: it is a South American knifefish, not closely related to true eels.

statement.ru: У многих сомов вкусовые рецепторы — по всему телу.
statement.en: Many catfish have taste receptors all over their bodies.

why: True: many larger catfish have chemoreceptors across their entire bodies.

statement.ru: Самые быстрые рыбы плавают быстрее 200 км/ч.
statement.en: The fastest fish swim at over 200 km/h.

why: False: even the dubious records (sailfish, marlin) are about 110 to 130 km/h; real swim speeds are far lower.

statement.ru: Во Франции есть сомы, которые выпрыгивают на берег за голубями.
statement.en: In France, some catfish lunge out onto the shore to catch pigeons.

why: True: wels catfish in the river Tarn beach themselves to grab pigeons at the water's edge (2012 study).

statement.ru: Рыбу-хирурга назвали так за то, что она лечит других рыб.
statement.en: The surgeonfish got its name because it treats other fish.

why: False: it is named for the scalpel-like spines by its tail.

statement.ru: Акулы невосприимчивы к раку.
statement.en: Sharks are immune to cancer.

why: False: a 1990s myth; tumours, some cancerous, have been found in many shark species.

statement.ru: У мурены в глотке есть вторые челюсти, которые выскакивают за добычей.
statement.en: A moray eel has a second set of jaws in its throat that shoot out to grab prey.

why: True: its pharyngeal jaws launch into the mouth to seize prey and pull it into the throat.

statement.ru: Мурена — это морская змея.
statement.en: A moray is a sea snake.

why: False: morays are fish, a family of true eels.

statement.ru: Детёныши песчаной акулы поедают друг друга ещё в утробе матери.
statement.en: Sand tiger shark pups eat each other while still inside their mother.

why: True: sand tiger embryos eat their neighbouring embryos in the womb.

statement.ru: Большая белая акула — самая крупная акула на свете.
statement.en: The great white is the biggest shark in the world.

why: False: the whale shark, up to about 19 m, is the largest shark and fish.

statement.ru: Древние римляне лечили головную боль электрическим скатом.
statement.en: Ancient Romans treated headaches with an electric ray.

why: True: the Roman doctor Scribonius Largus recorded torpedo fish as a cure for headaches and gout.

statement.ru: Летучая рыба машет плавниками, как птица крыльями.
statement.en: A flying fish flaps its fins like a bird flaps its wings.

why: False: it glides on outstretched fins, pushing off with its tail.

statement.ru: Летучая рыба может пролететь над водой 400 метров.
statement.en: A flying fish can travel 400 metres above the water.

why: True: using updrafts over waves it can cover up to 400 m in one flight.

statement.ru: Свет «фонарика» глубоководного удильщика дают бактерии.
statement.en: The light in a deep-sea anglerfish's lure comes from bacteria.

why: True: the lure holds bioluminescent bacteria that make it glow.

statement.ru: Рыба-прилипала питается кровью акулы, к которой присосалась.
statement.en: A remora feeds on the blood of the shark it clings to.

why: False: remoras are hitchhikers that eat scraps and droppings, not the host's blood.

statement.ru: Илистый прыгун может проводить на суше большую часть жизни.
statement.en: A mudskipper can spend most of its life on land.

why: True: mudskippers spend up to three quarters of their life on land, crawling on their fins.
